description: Ranged damage and party support. Horns and screeches buff the group on a shared cooldown, War Falcons fight alongside you, and Emerald and Woodland Arrows spend the bank while the party keeps the buff.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_ranger__farstrider.txt: 'Closest to Augmentation Evoker ... its identity is built around empowering allies' output ... It still does meaningful personal ranged damage on its own Advantage builder/finisher loop, with only minor incidental healing rather than a real HPS rotation.' That split is why the ally work is all ABILITIES (the two Horns on a shared exclusive_group, Battle Screech, Battle Prowess, Defense of the Ancients, Frenzy, Command Aura, Freedom) and the tree is the Ranger's own half: talent effects resolve against the owning character only. Stat priority is Hit > Agility > Crit > Haste > Armor Penetration, which is why this is the one Ranger tree with a haste node and no armour penetration node.

nodes.name: Cunning
nodes.description: Reduces the Archery Point cost of your abilities by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Focus regeneration by 15%'. Nothing in the engine regenerates archery_points, so the honest translation of a regeneration node is a cheaper kit: it buys the same number of extra casts per bank. POSITIVE is the reduction (talented_cost does cost * (1 - pct)).

nodes.name: Windrunner's Reach
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the range of your ranged abilities by 5 yds. In addition, your critical strike chance against Undead, Beasts, and Dragonkin is increased by 2%'. Neither range nor creature type is a thing the ability system can read, so the crit is unconditional.

nodes.name: Falcon Charmer
nodes.description: Increases your War Falcon's health and armor by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of War Falcons by 3 sec'. Summoned pets here are persistent rather than timed, so 'lasts longer' becomes 'survives longer'. pet_health and pet_armor are live because this spec actually summons one (Call War Falcon, effect_type summon_pet).

nodes.name: Survivalist
nodes.description: Increases the healing done by Survival Potion by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Survival Potion by -25%', and 'Drink Survival Potion yourself when eating poison or disease damage'. A flat cooldown key would take 5 turns off an 8-turn cooldown at full rank, so the node scales the heal instead. ability_<id>_healing is the key the heal path reads; ability_<id>_damage is ignored for heals, which is how 18 talents across four classes silently did nothing.

nodes.name: Blow the Horns!
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Horns by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Horn spells by -25%', and 'Woodland Arrow and the passive Blow the Horns! chip that cooldown back down, so a skilled Ranger keeps a Horn up far more than the raw cooldown suggests'. Woodland Arrow's half of that cannot exist - no cast can shorten another ability's cooldown - so the whole mechanic is concentrated here.

nodes.name: Dream Flowers
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to heal you for 40.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your damaging critical strikes now spawn a green Dream Flower ... When an ally runs over the flower, they consume it to heal for 3% maximum health'. There are no ground objects and no running over them, so the heal lands on the Ranger directly. CoA's own weakness note holds either way: 'Dream Flowers and Phoenix Plumes only fire off crits and finisher hits.'

nodes.name: Hunting Tactics
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Skullpiercer by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Skullpiercer is increased by 30% against Poisoned targets'. No ability can test the target's effects, so it is unconditional and smaller.

nodes.name: Razorquills
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your periodic effects by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the tick rate of Toxic Dart and Emerald Arrows by -20%'. One tick per turn is fixed, so faster ticks become harder ones.

nodes.name: Venom-Coated Seeds
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Snapseed and Quel'dorei Poison by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Snapseed now reduces the enemy's chance to hit by -15%'. hit_chance_taken on a monster debuff is read by nothing, so the node is damage on both of the spec's poison-flavoured abilities instead.

nodes.name: Thread the Needle
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to increase your haste by 10 for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Quick Shot or Falconstrike now reduce the cast time and cost of your next ability that consumes Advantage by -34%'. Cast time is haste here; the cost half cannot ride along, because all_ability_cost_pct is read through get_talent_effect and never sees a status effect's stat_mods.

nodes.name: Forest Herald
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 15% chance per rank to heal you for 30.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Toxic Dart and abilities that spend stacks of Advantage now have a 20% chance to spawn a green Dreamflower'. Same ground-object gap as Dream Flowers, and the second half of what CoA means by 'No external healer needed.'

nodes.name: Guidance
nodes.description: Increases your Physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Physical and Nature damage dealt by 1% for each War Falcon or Dragonhawk you have active'. Nothing can count active pets at damage time, so it is flat.

nodes.name: Wingman
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces all damage taken by -2% for each War Falcon or Dragonhawk you have active'. Pet-count scaling has no hook, so the per-falcon rate becomes a per-rank rate. damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION, not percentage points - this is the key convention the shipped Guardian got wrong on max_health_pct and reached 99,156 effective HP.

nodes.name: Gutpiercer
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 20% chance per rank to leave the target taking 3% more Magic damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by War Falcons and Dragonhawks now has a 15% chance to reduce the enemy's resistances by 75 and increase their Magic damage taken'. A pet's hits fire no proc on the owner, so it keys off the Ranger's own casts. The magic debuff is the spec's real support contribution to a caster group. School-specific damage-taken keys inside a status effect are percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Plumes of War
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Falconstrike and Emerald Arrow by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Falconstrike and Emerald Arrow by 15%. In addition, critical strikes with Falconstrike now increase the damage of subsequent Falconstrikes by 5%, stacking 5 times'. The stacking half has no hook.

nodes.name: Scavenger
nodes.description: Battle Screech lasts 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Battle Screech and reduces the cooldown of Snapseed by 5 sec'.

nodes.name: Falcon's Aid
nodes.description: Increases your War Falcon's damage by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 10% chance to summon a War Falcon to aid you in battle for 6 seconds'. Pets here are summoned and persistent rather than proc-spawned and timed, so more falcons becomes a better falcon. pet_damage is live for this spec because it has a real companion.

nodes.name: Forest Fighter
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Woodland Arrow and Emerald Arrow by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Skullpiercers or Emerald Arrows used with 5 stacks of Advantage now reduce the cooldown of Woodland Arrow by -5 sec'. Conditional cooldown reduction from another cast has no hook, so the node makes the pair hit harder instead.

nodes.name: To the Skies!
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Backstep by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Bushcraft Glider by -30 sec'. Bushcraft Glider is overworld movement, which this kit has no equivalent of, so the node moves onto Backstep, the spec's other repositioning tool. CoA lists the two together: 'Backstep, Bushcraft Glider and Falcon Guide's speed proc make you hard to pin down.'

nodes.name: Frenzy
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Frenzy's haste' is one of the free spec passives and also a party cooldown. The party half is the Frenzy ability; this node is the Ranger's own share, since a talent cannot reach allies.

nodes.name: Defense of the Ancients
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Defense of the Ancients' armor' aura, same split as Frenzy: the party aura is the ability, this is the Ranger's own armour. armor_pct is percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Pecking
nodes.description: Increases the damage you deal to additional targets by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your War Falcons and Dragonhawks now have a 25% chance to deal additional Physical damage to 3 nearby enemies'. Pet AoE is not something a talent can add to a pet template, so the node scales the Ranger's own cleave (Whipvine Arrow, Quills, Incendiary Shot).

nodes.name: Coordination
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 4%, your critical strike damage by 10%, and your War Falcon's damage by 6%.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Your War Falcons and Dragonhawks now grant you a stack of Coordination when they deal damage ... Increases your critical strike chance and critical damage by 1% for 15 seconds, stacking 10 times.' A pet's hits fire no proc on the owner, so the 10-stack ramp lands as its maximum value held permanently, and the falcon gets a share of it. Chosen over Thalassian Brand as the capstone because Brand is already a real ability in the kit and CoA rates this spec's own throughput 'moderate' - a passive ceiling fits better than another button.
